name: Predictive Buffer (Remake)
description: Looks a few ticks ahead and delays a tap by the smallest amount that avoids a death.

normal-ticks.name: Normal ticks
normal-ticks.description: Max delay in ticks for non-wave modes. 4 ticks = 1 frame at 60 fps.

wave-ticks.name: Wave ticks
wave-ticks.description: Max delay in ticks while in wave (presses and releases).

spam-interval.name: Spam interval (ticks)
spam-interval.description: Clicks closer together than this count as spam. 20 ticks = 12 clicks/sec.

look-ahead.name: Look-ahead (ticks)
look-ahead.description: How far ahead each check simulates. Higher is more accurate but heavier on weak phones.
